stories.title: Nearly half of young drivers admit to using a handheld phone at the wheel, RAC research finds
stories.summary: Almost half of drivers under 25 say they have made or received a phone call without a hands-free kit while driving in the past year, new research from the RAC shows. The figure stands at 49 per cent among under-25s, compared to 20 per cent of drivers overall, according to the motoring organisation’s annual survey.
